name: quantumshield
description: QuantumShield — Post-Quantum Trust for Critical Digital Records (hackathon prototype)

scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n server,quantum -c blue,magenta "npm run start -w server" "npm:dev:quantum"
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && node scripts/test-quantum.js
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
